messages:
Alex W: Hey team — CI red on PR #1851. Build succeeded but the image push step fails with weird HTTP/EOF during upload. Here's the job: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/51234 :(
Maria L: ugh. error output?
Alex W: paste from kaniko:
```
ERROR: failed to push to destination "registry.redwood.local/prod/myservice:pr-1851": error parsing HTTP 500 response body: unexpected EOF
```
Sam J: did anyone touch registry creds or retention policies? I didn't change anything in infra for this PR.
CI Bot: CI job 51234 — image push failed (kaniko). Rerun options: retry manual / auto-retry x1.
Maria L: can you try re-running the job first? most EOFs are transient when registry is GC-ing or under load.
Alex W: re-run queued (manually kicked). Will report.
eng-infra-bot: FYI we had a short spike on the registry around 2026-03-16 17:02 UTC — high concurrent uploads, errors ~15% for 5m. Logged in ops.
Sam J: this PR did reorder Dockerfile layers (moved ENV and deps earlier) — could be changing layer size and upload concurrency. What builder are we using? kaniko with --tar-uploads? any difference?
Alex W: kaniko v1.9, default parallel uploads. Dockerfile snippet changed:
```
- COPY package.json yarn.lock ./
- RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile
+ COPY . /app
+ RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile
```
so we now upload a bigger layer earlier.
Maria L: that would increase single-layer size, making upload more likely to hit registry edge-case if GC running. Try add `--single-snapshot` or `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` to kaniko for a rerun.
Alex W: re-run finished — still failing, same EOF.
Sam J: can you try building locally and pushing with `docker push` to isolate kaniko vs registry? Or do `skopeo copy` to see if it repros.
Alex W: tried local docker push to staging registry: succeeded. Pushed directly with docker CLI (no kaniko) to same registry and tag.
Maria L: that narrows it to kaniko/CI parallel uploads. eng-infra, any rate-limit changes on registry?
eng-infra-bot: No ACLs changed. We did a brief maintenance window yesterday (storage compaction). There's an incident ticket I opened: INC-487 (tracking backend objectstore flaps). Suggest lowering parallelism as a workaround until storage compaction finishes.
Sam J: quick bisect suggestion: try the PR build but with kaniko flag `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` and/or `--skip-tls-verify=false`? Also consider pinning the layer cache behavior.
Alex W: reconfigured CI for this run with `KANIKO_OPTS=--max-concurrent-uploads=1 --single-snapshot` and kicked it off.
CI Bot: CI rerun 51236 started.
Alex W: success! push completed. That was the charm.
Maria L: nice. Action items: 1) Alex — update PR CI config temporarily or add note in PR template to set KANIKO_OPTS if build uploads are large. 2) eng-infra — investigate INC-487 and see if storage compaction can be staggered to avoid upload races. 3) Devx — add a troubleshooting blurb in docs for "kaniko EOF during push" with the --max-concurrent-uploads workaround.
Alex W: created a tiny follow-up commit to set KANIKO_OPTS in CI for this PR and added a comment linking INC-487.
Sam J: thanks. Also maybe we should prefer splitting COPY to keep cache friendly and smaller layers.
Maria L: agreed. I'll follow up on docs. Closing for now :thumbsup:
